title: Built a browser-based AI escape game inspired by Baby’s Day Out (’90s movie)
author: AdPersonal1805
selftext:
Built a small browser game during a recent hackathon called “Baby’s Day Out”, inspired by the ’90s movie.

It’s a lighthearted escape game where you don’t control the baby directly — instead, you place toys, treats, and distractions to influence the baby with a mind of its own as it tries to escape a park.

I made it mostly for fun — to explore AI-driven character behavior, game engines, and some storytelling mechanics. Still rough around the edges and works best on desktop.

Would love your feedback, thoughts, or any cool ideas to evolve it!

Play here: [https://www.babydayout.xyz/](https://www.babydayout.xyz/)

comments.author: ZHName
comments.body:
Very nice. Ok so on EASY I struggled to get the baby past two streets. I think there needs to be some tweaking to make the baby more obedient to follow the objects (lower detection dist). On harder modes this is fine if the baby doesn't respond to objects  but on easy mode I should be able to play through to the end, right?

Graphics wise, I think it's possible to improve the edges on the map tiles and some more styling to the ux (borders that are hand drawn in Aseprite?). To give more polish.

Kudos for instructions that are clear and easy to read. Many people forget and/or don't make their gameplay intuitive for first-play scenario.
